$comment: Size budgets that fail CI when exceeded, gzipped. JS: size-limit with esbuild (entry bundled, minified). CSS: scripts/css-size.ts on the built files, which esbuild cannot measure. css: all of @nib-ui/css (tokens, base, components); utilities: the opt-in utilities file; cssModule: one component stylesheet built on its own; module: one JS module (a controller or a binding entry); heavyModule: combobox, date picker, data grid.
